{{Top|leg}}
A '''Sarrh'Tais''' ("lawland") was a region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coyn]] ruled over by a single [[Ag'Tra]] family. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], there were twenty-nine Sarrh'Tais.
